To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

relaying is more energy efficient than direct transmission when the circuit power consumptions are not considered, but it is not always the case when the circuit power consumption is taken into account.
(1) relaying is not necessarily more energy efficient than direct transmission; and (2) two-way relaying is not more energy efficient than one-way relaying in asymmetric systems.
relaying is only energy efficient in symmetric systems where circuit power consumptions at all nodes are identical and the data amounts in two directions are the same.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the impact of circuit PC, which is usually ignored in the literature.
the energy efficiency analysis of OWRT and TWRT, and provides some insights into the design of relay-based energy efficient communication systems.
the impact of circuit PC on EE and provides useful insights for the design of energy efficient relay systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
relaying is energy efficient in symmetric systems and when the number of bits to be sent in two directions is equal.
TWRT is more energy efficient than the other two strategies only when the circuit PCs at two source nodes are the same, and the numbers of information bits to be transmitted are equal.
the energy efficiencies of OWRT and TWRT are comparable and depend on the system parameters, and the energy efficiency of TWRT is more sensitive to the circuit PC than that of OWRT.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
TWRT is more energy efficient than other strategies in symmetric systems, while OWRT is more energy-efficient than TWRT in asymmetric systems.
relaying is a low energy consumption strategy only if the circuit PCs are negligible.

TWRT should be adopted when the numbers of information bits in two directions are almost the same and the circuit PCs at the nodes are almost the same; OWRT should be used if the number of information bits in each direction is not the same or the circuit PCs at different nodes are different.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the EE is determined by the PCs of the whole system, not by that of the transmission part only, so it is necessary to optimize the EE of a system by considering the PCs of the system as a whole.
, for energy-efficient wireless communications, it is necessary to take the circuit PCs of nodes into consideration when comparing different strategies.
the EE of relaying is not determined by its spectral efficiency.
